answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the velvet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
